title: Season 2
overview: Just when Matt thinks he is bringing order back to the city, new forces rise in Hell's Kitchen, including the lethal vigilante Frank Castle and Matt's former flame Elektra Natchios.

episodes.title: Bang
episodes.overview: A ruthless military vigilante wipes out the Irish Mob in Hell's Kitchen, drawing Daredevil into a dangerous confrontation.

episodes.title: Dogs to a Gunfight
episodes.overview: Suffering from head trauma after his rooftop duel with the Punisher, Matt investigates Frank Castle's tactical movements.

episodes.title: New York's Finest
episodes.overview: Chained to a rooftop chimney, Daredevil debates morality, lethal justice, and redemption with the unyielding Frank Castle.

episodes.title: Penny and Dime
episodes.overview: Daredevil rescues Frank Castle from the Irish Mob, listening to Castle's heartbreaking memory of his murdered family.

episodes.title: Kinbaku
episodes.overview: Matt's wealthy, enigmatic ex-lover Elektra Natchios resurfaces in New York, pulling him into her covert war against the Yakuza.

episodes.title: Regrets Only
episodes.overview: Matt and Elektra infiltrate a high-society gala to steal encrypted ledger data, while Nelson and Murdock agree to defend Frank Castle.

episodes.title: Semper Fidelis
episodes.overview: The trial of Frank Castle begins as Murdock's double life causes him to miss critical courtroom appearances.

episodes.title: Guilty as Sin
episodes.overview: Stick testifies in defense of Castle, while Castle intentionally explodes on the witness stand after a prison visitor contacts him.

episodes.title: Seven Minutes in Heaven
episodes.overview: Inside Ryker's Island, Wilson Fisk orchestrates a brutal gang war and manipulates Frank Castle into eliminating a rival boss.

episodes.title: The Man in the Box
episodes.overview: Matt visits Fisk in prison, realizing Kingpin intends to destroy Hell's Kitchen upon release, while Elektra rejects Stick's orders.
Daredevil investigates Black Sky, while Frank Castle hunts down the Blacksmith heroin kingpin across the waterfront.

episodes.title: The Dark at the End of the Tunnel
episodes.overview: Stick is captured by Hand ninjas, forcing Daredevil and Elektra to fight their way through ancient underground catacombs.

episodes.title: A Cold Day in Hell's Kitchen
episodes.overview: Daredevil and Elektra battle Nobu and the Hand on a Hell's Kitchen rooftop, where Elektra sacrifices her life to save Matt.

verification.notes: Confirmed Season 2 of Daredevil. 13 episodes released simultaneously on Netflix on March 18, 2016.
